name: walletkit-web
description: WalletKit enables users to hold credentials and prove their humanity with World ID .

scripts.generate: bun run patch:generator && ubrn build wasm2 --config ubrn.config.yaml --release && node scripts/optimize-wasm.mjs && node scripts/patch-generated-index.mjs
scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run generate && bun run bundle
scripts.bundle: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild src/index.ts src/walletkit.worker.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2022 --outdir=dist --footer:js="export {};" && node scripts/copy-wasm.mjs
scripts.test:browser: tsc -p tests/fixture/tsconfig.json && vite build --config tests/vite.config.ts && playwright test
